newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Velazquez may leave hospital soon-doctor.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Velazquez may leave hospital soon-doctor.

text.p: Powerful Mexican labor boss Fidel Velazquez, 97, could leave the hospital as soon as Sunday, his doctor said on Monday.

Velazquez, a pillar of the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) who has swung key labor support behind the government for 60 years, entered the hospital on Thursday with a urinary tract infection, the latest in a series of hospital stays for the frail leader.
His doctor, Salomon Jasqui, told Reuters that Velazquez could leave by "next Sunday, Father's Day. I'm going to give him that gift."
But Jasqui said his patient should continue resting for about a week after leaving the hosptial.
Velazquez is chief of the 6 million-strong Confederation of Mexican Workers (CTM) and has no heir apparent.
